images.author: Nyttend
images.caption: Front and northern side of the Freeland T. Barney House, located at 213-215 Fulton Street in Sandusky, Ohio, United States.  Built in 1850, it is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

brief: A resort-town cottage lot: Freeland T. Barney House, a 19th-century lake-town house. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: northern Michigan resort cottages of this kind are 1880-1950 buildings; Commons has almost no newer ones. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the Freeland T. Barney House (Sandusky): a big limestone house with gabled dormers, a later frame bay and arched porch on the front, a frame sunroom wing, wooden fire stairs and decks on the side: a rooming house; a cracked drive

why.note: a stone mansion cut into flats with outside stairs
